info.title: Mioz Arena
info.author: miozwalis-ai
info.description: Survive against zombies in a field
info.details:
Mioz Arena (v1.0) is a beginner homebrew survival game for Nintendo Switch. Explore a green field with trees while small zombies chase you. Note: In this first version, the vertical joystick axis is inverted. Developer feedback and contributions are welcome!


AI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.
